<h2>Run One sjSDM Predictor Structure Across Selected Folds</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Applies one controlled predictor structure to deterministic
selected-candidate folds and returns labelled predictions and diagnostics.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>run_sjsdm_predictor_structure_folds(
  predictor_structure = NULL,
  data_assignments = NULL,
  data_selected_candidate = NULL,
  data_community_matrix = NULL,
  data_abiotic_wide = NULL,
  data_coords_projected = NULL,
  data_sample_ids = NULL,
  config_model_fitting = NULL,
  config_data_processing = NULL,
  model_formula = NULL,
  device = "gpu",
  seed = 900723L,
  prepare_fold_function = prepare_sjsdm_cross_validation_fold,
  fit_candidate_function = fit_sjsdm_regularization_candidate,
  runner_function = run_sjsdm_selected_candidate_folds,
  predict_function = predict_sjsdm_probability_matrix
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="predictor_structure">predictor_structure</code></td>
<td>
<p>Structure passed to [configure_sjsdm_predictor_structure()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_assignments">data_assignments</code>, <code id="data_selected_candidate">data_selected_candidate</code>, <code id="data_community_matrix">data_community_matrix</code></td>
<td>
<p>Cross-validation assignments, selected regularization, and response matrix.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_abiotic_wide">data_abiotic_wide</code>, <code id="data_coords_projected">data_coords_projected</code>, <code id="data_sample_ids">data_sample_ids</code></td>
<td>
<p>Abiotic predictors, projected coordinates, and aligned sample metadata.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="config_model_fitting">config_model_fitting</code>, <code id="config_data_processing">config_data_processing</code></td>
<td>
<p>Model-fitting and data-processing configurations used by fold preparation.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="model_formula">model_formula</code></td>
<td>
<p>Full abiotic formula used when abiotic predictors are enabled.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="device">device</code></td>
<td>
<p>Fitting device passed to [fit_sjsdm_regularization_candidate()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="seed">seed</code></td>
<td>
<p>Base selected-fold seed passed to
[run_sjsdm_selected_candidate_folds()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="prepare_fold_function">prepare_fold_function</code>, <code id="fit_candidate_function">fit_candidate_function</code>, <code id="runner_function">runner_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable functions for fold preparation, candidate fitting, and selected
fold orchestration.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="predict_function">predict_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable held-out prediction function.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>Regularization and assignments are fixed by the supplied reference inputs.
The helper changes predictor inclusion only. Intercept-only and spatial-only
structures use an environmental intercept because sjSDM requires an
environmental component. The no-associations structure retains abiotic and
spatial predictors while restricting the biotic covariance to its diagonal.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Named list containing labelled 'data_predictions' and 'data_diagnostics'.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>## Not run:
run_sjsdm_predictor_structure_folds(
  predictor_structure = "abiotic_only",
  data_assignments = data_assignments,
  data_selected_candidate = data_selected_candidate,
  data_community_matrix = data_community_matrix,
  data_abiotic_wide = data_abiotic_wide,
  data_coords_projected = data_coords_projected,
  data_sample_ids = data_sample_ids,
  config_model_fitting = config_model_fitting,
  config_data_processing = config_data_processing,
  model_formula = model_formula
)

## End(Not run)
</code></pre>
